notes: Gautam Budh Nagar (Noida) is NOT in NCRB's metropolitan-city table (Noida's 2011 Census population was below 2M), so per-category city totals are stitched from the Gautam Budh Nagar Police Commissionerate's year-end press conference as reported by ThePrint and Millennium Post in Jan 2024. That single article published 2021/2022/2023 figures side-by-side, which is why all three years share the same primary source. Category mapping: theft = vehicle theft (the only theft sub-figure published by GBN Police press conferences; no separable total-theft figure exists for these years - documented to keep trend-chart comparability); robbery = 'loot' cases; assault = murder cases (attempt-to-murder not reported in the press for these years, so assault is murder-only here, NOT murder+ATM as in other cities); sexual_offence = rape cases; burglary = house burglary cases. harassment, kidnapping and other are null because GBN police did not break these out in the reported press conferences - dowry deaths (44/31/26) and total crimes-against-women (596/576/453) exist but don't map cleanly to the project's category enum so they're omitted rather than misclassified. 2019 and 2020 omitted: although a Deccan Herald 2020 article exists ('Encounters went up by nearly 65% in 2020; rapes, murders down: Noida Police'), its body could not be retrieved to extract verified per-category figures, so per the project's hard rule those years are skipped rather than fabricated. Cross-check on year-over-year trend: ThePrint reports a 21% decline in crimes-against-women from 2022 (576) to 2023 (453) and notable drops in murder (53->50), rape (33->30), vehicle theft (1336->1098), loot (39->29), burglary (141->88) - all internally consistent and consistent with the article's 'crime graph dips' framing.
